overview_description.description: Ciro offers a search engine for sales teams and automates many manual time-consuming tasks. Sales teams may increase income with Ciro thanks to a sales prospecting tool that is specifically designed for enterprises that sell to SMBs and local businesses. The platform sends out timely business alerts regarding things like modifications to software subscriptions, freshly hired personnel, or fresh social media posts. Through the use of the Ciro platform, sales teams can create workflows around these alerts to drastically cut down on research time and latency, freeing up their team to speak with consumers more often.
